manifest.build: mbx build --release -p sparkles --features ontology --example entity_search_bench on atlas
manifest.build_note: Built from the lane's working tree synchronized to atlas, whose crates/sparkles sources equal the commit.

legacy_metadata.method: entity_search_bench ONTOLOGY.owl --per-bucket 60 --rounds 5 --seed 1 --commits 50, one process per ontology under the host's heavy-work lock with no other build, test or benchmark running. The ontology is loaded into a persistent dataset, the first search builds the index, and 60 seeded queries per bucket of prefix length 1 to 12 and 0 to 2 typos run five times each after a warm-up pass through wire::call(ds, "search"), the call of the HTTP route, JSON answer included. Fifty commits then each add a labelled class or remove a label, with the search after each one timed.
